risk_note: RV2 payout (withdraw lane B2-05l; model Claude Fable 5.1). A read-only port for the notification module (D10-260: wallet.withdrawal_changed keeps {withdrawal_id, user_id, status}; notification reads the withdrawal here to pick the WD_REJECTED sentence): createWithdrawalNotificationReader().read(handle, {appId, withdrawalId}) runs one SELECT of twelve explicit columns on withdrawals scoped to the app (another app or unknown id → null), on the caller's handle, returning bigint fen as stored and Date instants; no payee / personal column is selected, nothing is decrypted, written or logged. Exported through payout/index.ts; read.ts is unchanged (frozen [AC-B2-05f#10] pins it to listWithdrawalsForUser). No money movement, no state change.
